kubernetes/control-plane-components/api-: Kubernetes API server (kube-apiserver): the control-plane front end that validates and serves all REST requests to the cluster.
kubernetes/control-plane-components/clou: Kubernetes cloud-controller-manager: control-plane component linking the cluster to a cloud provider's load balancers, routes and nodes.
kubernetes/control-plane-components/cont: Kubernetes kube-controller-manager: runs the core control loops that reconcile nodes, replicas, endpoints and other objects to desired state.
kubernetes/control-plane-components/kube: kube-proxy: network proxy on each Kubernetes node that maintains iptables or IPVS rules implementing Service routing.
Kubelet: the node agent that starts and monitors a Kubernetes node's pod containers and reports status to the API server.
kubernetes/control-plane-components/sche: Kubernetes scheduler (kube-scheduler): control-plane component that assigns newly created pods to suitable nodes based on resources and constraints.
kubernetes/infrastructure-components/con: Kubernetes control plane: the set of components (API server, scheduler, controllers, etcd) that manage the cluster's state.
kubernetes/infrastructure-components/etc: etcd: the consistent, distributed key-value store that Kubernetes uses as the backing store for all cluster data.
kubernetes/infrastructure-components/nod: Kubernetes node: a worker machine, virtual or physical, that runs pods via the kubelet and a container runtime.
kubernetes/resources/cluster-role: Kubernetes ClusterRole: a cluster-wide set of RBAC permissions, usable across all namespaces or for non-namespaced resources.
kubernetes/resources/cluster-role-bindin: Kubernetes ClusterRoleBinding (CRB): grants a ClusterRole's permissions to users, groups or service accounts across the whole cluster.
kubernetes/resources/config-map: Kubernetes ConfigMap (cm): stores non-confidential configuration as key-value pairs that pods consume as environment variables or files.
kubernetes/resources/cron-job: Kubernetes CronJob: creates Jobs on a repeating cron schedule, for periodic tasks like backups, reports or cleanup.
kubernetes/resources/custom-resource-def: Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition (CRD): extends the Kubernetes API with a new custom resource type, often managed by an operator.
kubernetes/resources/daemon-set: Kubernetes DaemonSet (ds): ensures a copy of a pod runs on every matching node, typical for log agents and monitoring.
kubernetes/resources/deployment: Kubernetes Deployment (deploy): declaratively manages ReplicaSets of stateless pods, handling rolling updates and rollbacks.
kubernetes/resources/endpoints: Kubernetes Endpoints (ep): object listing the pod IP addresses and ports that currently back a Service.
kubernetes/resources/group: Kubernetes group: a set of authenticated users referenced as a subject in RBAC RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings.
kubernetes/resources/horizontal-pod-auto: Kubernetes HorizontalPodAutoscaler (HPA): automatically scales a workload's replica count based on CPU, memory or custom metrics.
kubernetes/resources/ingress: Kubernetes Ingress (ing): defines HTTP and HTTPS routing rules from outside the cluster to Services, via an ingress controller.
kubernetes/resources/job: Kubernetes Job: runs one or more pods to completion, for batch work or one-off tasks such as database migrations.
kubernetes/resources/limit-range: Kubernetes LimitRange: sets default, minimum and maximum CPU and memory constraints for pods and containers in a namespace.
kubernetes/resources/namespace: Kubernetes Namespace (ns): a virtual partition of a cluster that scopes resource names, quotas and access policies.
kubernetes/resources/network-policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (netpol): controls which pods and endpoints may send traffic to or from selected pods.
kubernetes/resources/persistent-volume: Kubernetes PersistentVolume (PV): a cluster storage resource provisioned by an admin or dynamically through a StorageClass.
kubernetes/resources/persistent-volume-c: Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC): a pod's request for storage of a given size and access mode, bound to a PersistentVolume.
kubernetes/resources/pod: Kubernetes Pod: the smallest deployable unit, one or more containers sharing network and storage, scheduled together on a node.
kubernetes/resources/pod-security-policy: Kubernetes PodSecurityPolicy (PSP): deprecated, removed in 1.25, cluster policy that restricted security-sensitive pod settings like privileged mode.
kubernetes/resources/replica-set: Kubernetes ReplicaSet (rs): keeps a specified number of identical pod replicas running, usually managed by a Deployment.
kubernetes/resources/resource-quota: Kubernetes ResourceQuota: caps aggregate resource consumption and object counts, such as CPU, memory or pods, within a namespace.
kubernetes/resources/role: Kubernetes Role: a namespaced set of RBAC permissions defining which verbs are allowed on which resources.
kubernetes/resources/role-binding: Kubernetes RoleBinding (rb): grants a Role or ClusterRole's permissions to users, groups or service accounts within one namespace.
kubernetes/resources/secret: Kubernetes Secret: stores sensitive data such as passwords, tokens or TLS keys for pods to mount or read as environment variables.
kubernetes/resources/service: Kubernetes Service (svc): a stable virtual IP and DNS name that load-balances traffic across a set of selected pods.
kubernetes/resources/service-account: Kubernetes ServiceAccount (sa): an identity for processes running in pods, used to authenticate to the API server.
kubernetes/resources/stateful-set: Kubernetes StatefulSet (sts): manages stateful pods with stable identities, ordered rollout and per-pod persistent storage, e.g. databases.
kubernetes/resources/storage-class: Kubernetes StorageClass (sc): describes a class of storage and its provisioner, enabling dynamic PersistentVolume provisioning.
kubernetes/resources/user: Kubernetes user: a human or external identity authenticated by the cluster and referenced as a subject in RBAC bindings.
kubernetes/resources/volume: Kubernetes volume (vol): a directory of data mounted into a pod's containers, backed by emptyDir, ConfigMap, PVC and others.
